name: digitalai-release-mcp
description: Run, manage, and troubleshoot your release pipelines with Claude
long_description: Claude works directly inside your Digital.ai Release pipelines: find and start releases, build templates with phases, tasks, and gates, manage variables and configurations, and pull activity logs to diagnose failures. Claude acts with the permissions of your Personal Access Token, and read-only mode lets you explore safely without making changes. Requires Release 26.1.5+.

release_url.title: Release server URL
release_url.description: https://release.mycompany.com — the base URL of your Release instance. — If your server uses a non-default servlet path or context root, paste the full MCP endpoint URL instead.

personal_access_token.title: Personal Access Token
personal_access_token.description: Create one in Release under User profile > Access tokens. Claude acts with this user's permissions.
